title: Parkour Runner with Time Control
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with a Three.js parkour runner game featuring time manipulation mechanics. The game should include:

## Scene Setup
- Use Three.js with a perspective camera (FOV 60, near 0.1, far 1000) positioned at (0, 8, 15) looking toward the runner.
- Add a directional light at (5, 15, 10) with intensity 1.2, and ambient light with intensity 0.4.
- Sky background color #87CEEB.
- The camera follows the runner from behind with a smooth lerp (factor 0.1).

## Runner Character
- A capsule-shaped runner made from a CylinderGeometry (radius 0.4, height 1.2) with a SphereGeometry head (radius 0.4) on top, colored #FF4444.
- The runner starts at position (0, 1.0, 0) on the first platform.
- Runner has properties: velocityX, velocityY, velocityZ, isGrounded, isAlive.
- Gravity: -25 units/s² (applied to velocityY when not grounded).
- The runner automatically moves forward (negative Z) at a base speed of 8 units/s.

## Platforms & Obstacles
- Generate a procedural course of 20 platforms stretching along negative Z axis.
- Each platform is a BoxGeometry with width 4, height 0.5, varying lengths (4-10), colored with alternating #44AA44 and #338833.
- Platforms are placed with gaps between them (1-3 units) and occasional height differences (0-2 units up).
- Place red obstacle boxes (BoxGeometry 1x1.5x0.5, color #CC0000) on some platforms (every 3rd platform).
- Place yellow coin rings (TorusGeometry, color #FFD700) floating above platforms (every 2nd platform), rotating slowly.

## Physics & Movement
- **Jump**: Press SPACE to jump. Apply velocityY = 10 when grounded. Double jump allowed (max 2 jumps before landing).
- **Slide**: Press S or DOWN arrow to slide. Shrink the runner height to 0.6 for 0.8 seconds. Can pass under obstacles while sliding.
- **Lane switching**: Press A/LEFT to move left, D/RIGHT to move right. Three lanes at x = -2.5, 0, 2.5. Smooth transition (lerp 0.15).
- Collision with obstacles when not sliding kills the runner (isAlive = false).
- Falling below y = -5 kills the runner.
- Collecting coins increments score by 100.

## Time Control Mechanic
- **Slow Motion**: Hold SHIFT to activate slow motion. Time scale reduces to 0.25 (quarter speed). Everything slows: runner movement, gravity, obstacles, coins rotation.
- Time energy bar starts at 100. Slow motion drains 20 energy/second. Energy recharges at 10/second when not using slow motion.
- When energy reaches 0, slow motion is forcibly deactivated.
- **Time Freeze**: Press F to freeze time completely for 1.5 real seconds. Costs 50 energy. Runner can still look around but nothing moves. Cooldown of 5 seconds.
- Visual effect: when slow motion is active, add a blue-tinted post-processing feel by changing the scene background to #4A6E8A and reducing light intensity to 0.7.

## HUD / UI
- Top-left: 'Score: X' in white, 24px bold font.
- Top-center: 'Distance: X m' showing how far the runner has traveled (in Z units, displayed as positive meters).
- Top-right: 'Speed: Xm/s' showing current effective speed.
- Below top-center: Time Energy bar (200px wide, 15px tall) - green fill that shrinks as energy depletes, with border.
- Center screen: 'SLOW MOTION' text appears in cyan when slow motion is active.
- Center screen: 'TIME FROZEN' text appears in blue when time freeze is active.
- On death: show 'GAME OVER' in red 48px font and a 'Restart' button (id='restartBtn').
- A 'Start' button (id='startBtn') shown initially. Game begins paused until clicked.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
- runnerX, runnerY, runnerZ: runner world position
- velocityY: vertical velocity
- isGrounded: boolean
- isAlive: boolean
- isSliding: boolean
- currentLane: -1 (left), 0 (center), 1 (right)
- score: number (coins * 100)
- distance: positive number (meters traveled)
- timeScale: current time scale (1.0 normal, 0.25 slow, 0.0 frozen)
- timeEnergy: 0-100
- isSlowMotion: boolean
- isTimeFrozen: boolean
- freezeCooldown: seconds remaining on freeze cooldown
- jumpCount: 0-2 (resets on ground)
- gameStarted: boolean
- platformCount: number of platforms generated
- coinsCollected: number of coins collected
- baseSpeed: the forward movement speed (8)
- effectiveSpeed: baseSpeed * timeScale
physics_constraints: Gravity is -25 units/s². Jump velocity is 10 units/s upward. Max 2 jumps before landing. Slow motion sets timeScale to 0.25. Time freeze sets timeScale to 0.0 for 1.5 real seconds. Energy drains at 20/s during slow motion, recharges at 10/s. Freeze costs 50 energy with 5s cooldown. Runner dies below y=-5 or on obstacle collision (when not sliding). Three lanes at x=-2.5, 0, 2.5.
